about: The exact-answer tier: LightSim against closed-form solutions, the same engine the vehicle cases use. backend/tests/test_numerics.py holds more of these.

cases.name: Coast-down under air drag alone
cases.formula: v(t) = v0 / (1 + k v0 t), k = C x 12.96 / m (C in N/(km/h)^2, v in m/s)

cases.name: Coast-down against A + B v + C v^2, solved to the time it takes from 100 to 20 km/h
cases.formula: t = m x integral from 20 to 100 km/h of dv / F(v) (numerical quadrature)
